map.哪些情况不保守？: Which situations are not suitable for conservative management?
map.发热+梗阻（脓肾风险）、肾功能受损、结石>10mm 上段、剧痛不止，需紧急干预而: Fever plus obstruction (risk of pyonephrosis), impaired renal function, upper tract stones >10 mm and unremitting severe pain require urgent intervention rather than waiting for passage.
map.不同大小的排石概率大概多少？: What is the approximate passage probability by size?
map.<5 mm 的输尿管下段结石自发排石率可达 60–80%；5–10 mm 明显下: Distal ureteral stones <5 mm have a spontaneous passage rate of up to 60-80%; for 5-10 mm it drops markedly to about 20-50%; >10 mm rarely pass on their own. The lower and the smaller the stone, the easier it passes; conservative waiting does not apply when infection, a solitary kidney or uncontrolled severe pain is present.
